verses.original: הָעִ֣זוּ׀ בְּנֵ֣י בִניָמִ֗ן מִקֶּ֙רֶב֙ יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם תִּקְע֣וּ שׁוֹפָ֔ר וּבִתְק֙וֹעַ֙ שְׂא֣וּ מַשְׂאֵ֑ת וְעַל־ בֵּ֥ית הַכֶּ֖רֶם כִּ֥י רָעָ֛ה נִשְׁקְפָ֥ה מִצָּפ֖וֹן גָּדֽוֹל׃ וְשֶׁ֥בֶר
verses.transliteration: hā·‘i·zū bə·nê ḇi·n·yå̄·min miq·qe·reḇ yə·rū·šā·lim tiq·‘ū šō·w·p̄ār ū·ḇiṯ·qō·w·a‘ śə·’ū maś·’êṯ wə·‘al- bêṯ hak·ke·rem kî rā·‘āh niš·qə·p̄āh miṣ·ṣā·p̄ō·wn gā·ḏō·wl wə·še·ḇer
verses.literal: Run for cover O sons of Benjamin [flee from] Jerusalem Sound the ram’s horn in Tekoa send up a signal over vvv Beth-haccherem for disaster looms from the north even great destruction

verses.original: הַנָּוָה֙ וְהַמְּעֻנָּגָ֔ה דָּמִ֖יתִי בַּת־ צִיּֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: han·nā·wāh wə·ham·mə·‘un·nā·ḡāh dā·mî·ṯî baṯ- ṣî·yō·wn
verses.literal: Though she is beautiful and delicate I will destroy the Daughter of Zion

verses.original: רֹעִ֖ים וְעֶדְרֵיהֶ֑ם יָבֹ֥אוּ אֵלֶ֛יהָ תָּקְע֨וּ עָלֶ֤יהָ אֹהָלִים֙ סָבִ֔יב רָע֖וּ אִ֥ישׁ אֶת־ יָדֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: rō·‘îm wə·‘eḏ·rê·hem yā·ḇō·’ū ’ê·le·hā tā·qə·‘ū ‘ā·le·hā ’ō·hā·lîm sā·ḇîḇ rā·‘ū ’îš ’eṯ- yā·ḏōw
verses.literal: Shepherds and their flocks will come against her they will pitch . . . their tents all around her . . . each - tending his own portion

verses.original: קַדְּשׁ֤וּ מִלְחָמָ֔ה עָלֶ֙יהָ֙ ק֖וּמוּ וְנַעֲלֶ֣ה בַֽצָּהֳרָ֑יִם א֥וֹי לָ֙נוּ֙ כִּי־ הַיּ֔וֹם כִּ֥י פָנָ֣ה עָֽרֶב׃ צִלְלֵי־ יִנָּט֖וּ
verses.transliteration: qad·də·šū mil·ḥā·māh ‘ā·le·hā qū·mū wə·na·‘ă·leh ḇaṣ·ṣā·ho·rā·yim ’ō·w lā·nū kî- hay·yō·wm kî p̄ā·nāh ‘ā·reḇ ṣil·lê- yin·nā·ṭū
verses.literal: Prepare for battle against her rise up let us attack at noon Woe to us for the daylight . . . is fading the evening shadows grow long

verses.original: ק֚וּמוּ וְנַעֲלֶ֣ה בַלָּ֔יְלָה וְנַשְׁחִ֖יתָה אַרְמְנוֹתֶֽיהָ׃ס
verses.transliteration: qū·mū wə·na·‘ă·leh ḇal·lā·yə·lāh wə·naš·ḥî·ṯāh ’ar·mə·nō·w·ṯe·hā
verses.literal: Rise up let us attack by night and destroy her fortresses

verses.original: כִּ֣י כֹ֤ה יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת אָמַר֙ כִּרְת֣וּ עֵצָ֔ה וְשִׁפְכ֥וּ סֹלְלָ֑ה עַל־ יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם הִ֚יא הָעִ֣יר הָפְקַ֔ד כֻּלָּ֖הּ עֹ֥שֶׁק בְּקִרְבָּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: kî ḵōh Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ’ā·mar kir·ṯū ‘ê·ṣāh wə·šip̄·ḵū sō·lə·lāh ‘al- yə·rū·šā·lim hî hā·‘îr hā·p̄ə·qaḏ kul·lāh ‘ō·šeq bə·qir·bāh
verses.literal: For this is what the LORD of Hosts says Cut down the trees and raise a siege ramp against Jerusalem This city must be punished there is nothing but oppression in her midst

verses.original: בְּוֵר כְּהָקִ֥יר מֵימֶ֔יהָ כֵּ֖ן הֵקֵ֣רָה רָעָתָ֑הּ חָמָ֣ס וָ֠שֹׁד יִשָּׁ֨מַע בָּ֧הּ חֳלִ֥י וּמַכָּֽה׃ תָּמִ֖יד עַל־ פָּנַ֛י
verses.transliteration: bə·wēr kə·hā·qîr mê·me·hā kên hê·qê·rāh rā·‘ā·ṯāh ḥā·mās wā·šōḏ yiš·šā·ma‘ bāh ḥo·lî ū·mak·kāh tā·mîḏ ‘al- pā·nay
verses.literal: As a well gushes its water so she pours out her evil Violence and destruction resound in her sickness and wounds are ever before Me

verses.original: הִוָּסְרִי֙ יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם פֶּן־ נַפְשִׁ֖י תֵּקַ֥ע מִמֵּ֑ךְ פֶּן־ אֲשִׂימֵ֣ךְ שְׁמָמָ֔ה אֶ֖רֶץ ל֥וֹא נוֹשָֽׁבָה׃פ
verses.transliteration: hiw·wā·sə·rî yə·rū·šā·lim pen- nap̄·šî tê·qa‘ mim·mêḵ pen- ’ă·śî·mêḵ šə·mā·māh ’e·reṣ lō·w nō·wō·šā·ḇāh
verses.literal: Be forewarned O Jerusalem or I will turn away from you . . . I will make you a desolation a land without inhabitant

verses.original: כֹּ֤ה יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת אָמַר֙ שְׁאֵרִ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל עוֹלֵ֛ל יְעוֹלְל֥וּ כַגֶּ֖פֶן יָדְךָ֔ הָשֵׁב֙ כְּבוֹצֵ֖ר עַל־ סַלְסִלּֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: kōh Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ’ā·mar šə·’ê·rîṯ yiś·rā·’êl ‘ō·w·lêl yə·‘ō·wl·lū ḵag·ge·p̄en yā·ḏə·ḵā hā·šêḇ kə·ḇō·w·ṣêr ‘al- sal·sil·lō·wṯ
verses.literal: This is what the LORD of Hosts says {Glean} the remnant of Israel as thoroughly . . . as a vine Pass your hand once more like a grape gatherer over the branches

verses.original: עַל־ מִ֨י אֲדַבְּרָ֤ה וְאָעִ֙ידָה֙ וְיִשְׁמָ֔עוּ הִנֵּה֙ אָזְנָ֔ם עֲרֵלָ֣ה וְלֹ֥א יוּכְל֖וּ לְהַקְשִׁ֑יב הִנֵּ֣ה דְבַר־ יְהוָ֗ה הָיָ֥ה לְחֶרְפָּ֖ה לָהֶ֛ם לֹ֥א יַחְפְּצוּ־ בֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ‘al- mî ’ă·ḏab·bə·rāh wə·’ā·‘î·ḏāh wə·yiš·mā·‘ū hin·nêh ’ā·zə·nām ‘ă·rê·lāh wə·lō yū·ḵə·lū lə·haq·šîḇ hin·nêh ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh hā·yāh lə·ḥer·pāh lā·hem lō yaḥ·pə·ṣū- ḇōw
verses.literal: To whom can I give this warning Who will listen [to me] Look their ears are closed so they cannot . . . hear See the word of the LORD has become offensive to them they find no pleasure in it

verses.original: וְאֵת֩ מָלֵ֙אתִי֙ יְהוָ֤ה׀ חֲמַ֨ת נִלְאֵ֣יתִי הָכִ֔יל שְׁפֹ֤ךְ עַל־ עוֹלָל֙ בַּח֔וּץ וְעַ֛ל בַּחוּרִ֖ים ס֥וֹד יַחְדָּ֑ו כִּֽי־ גַם־ אִ֤ישׁ עִם־ אִשָּׁה֙ יִלָּכֵ֔דוּ זָקֵ֖ן עִם־ מְלֵ֥א יָמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êṯ mā·lê·ṯî Yah·weh ḥă·maṯ nil·’ê·ṯî hā·ḵîl šə·p̄ōḵ ‘al- ‘ō·w·lāl ba·ḥūṣ wə·‘al ba·ḥū·rîm sō·wḏ yaḥ·dāw kî- ḡam- ’îš ‘im- ’iš·šāh yil·lā·ḵê·ḏū zā·qên ‘im- mə·lê yā·mîm
verses.literal: - But I am full of the LORD’s wrath I am tired of holding it back Pour it out on the children in the street and on the young men gathered together For both husband and wife will be captured the old and the very old [alike] . . .

verses.original: בָֽתֵּיהֶם֙ וְנָסַ֤בּוּ לַאֲחֵרִ֔ים שָׂד֥וֹת וְנָשִׁ֖ים יַחְדָּ֑ו כִּֽי־ אַטֶּ֧ה אֶת־ יָדִ֛י עַל־ יֹשְׁבֵ֥י הָאָ֖רֶץ נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ḇāt·tê·hem wə·nā·sab·bū la·’ă·ḥê·rîm śā·ḏō·wṯ wə·nā·šîm yaḥ·dāw kî- ’aṭ·ṭeh ’eṯ- yā·ḏî ‘al- yō·šə·ḇê hā·’ā·reṣ nə·’um- Yah·weh
verses.literal: Their houses will be turned over to others their fields and wives as well for I will stretch out - My hand against the inhabitants of the land declares the LORD

verses.original: כִּ֤י מִקְּטַנָּם֙ וְעַד־ גְּדוֹלָ֔ם כֻּלּ֖וֹ בּוֹצֵ֣עַ בָּ֑צַע וּמִנָּבִיא֙ וְעַד־ כֹּהֵ֔ן כֻּלּ֖וֹ עֹ֥שֶׂה שָּֽׁקֶר׃
verses.transliteration: kî miq·qə·ṭan·nām wə·‘aḏ- gə·ḏō·w·lām kul·lōw bō·w·ṣê·a‘ bā·ṣa‘ ū·min·nā·ḇî wə·‘aḏ- kō·hên kul·lōw ‘ō·śeh šā·qer
verses.literal: For from the least of them to the greatest all are greedy for gain from prophet to priest all practice deceit

verses.original: וַֽיְרַפְּא֞וּ אֶת־ שֶׁ֤בֶר עַמִּי֙ עַל־ נְקַלָּ֔ה לֵאמֹ֖ר שָׁל֣וֹם׀ שָׁל֑וֹם וְאֵ֖ין שָׁלֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: way·rap·pə·’ū ’eṯ- še·ḇer ‘am·mî ‘al- nə·qal·lāh lê·mōr šā·lō·wm šā·lō·wm wə·’ên šā·lō·wm
verses.literal: They dress the wound of My people with very little care saying Peace peace when there is no peace [at all]

verses.original: הֹבִ֕ישׁוּ תוֹעֵבָ֖ה כִּ֥י עָשׂ֑וּ גַּם־ לֹֽא־ יֵב֗וֹשׁוּ בּ֣וֹשׁ גַּם־ לֹ֣א יָדָ֔עוּ הַכְלִים֙ לָכֵ֞ן יִפְּל֧וּ בַנֹּפְלִ֛ים בְּעֵת־ פְּקַדְתִּ֥ים יִכָּשְׁל֖וּ אָמַ֥ר יְהוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: hō·ḇî·šū ṯō·w·‘ê·ḇāh kî ‘ā·śū gam- lō- yê·ḇō·wō·šū bō·wōš gam- lō yā·ḏā·‘ū haḵ·lîm lā·ḵên yip·pə·lū ḇan·nō·p̄ə·lîm bə·‘êṯ- pə·qaḏ·tîm yik·kā·šə·lū ’ā·mar Yah·weh
verses.literal: Are they ashamed of the abomination - they have committed No they have no shame at all . . . they do not even know how to blush So they will fall among the fallen when I punish them they will collapse says the LORD

verses.original: כֹּ֣ה יְהוָ֡ה אָמַ֣ר עִמְדוּ֩ עַל־ דְּרָכִ֨ים וּרְא֜וּ וְשַׁאֲל֣וּ׀ עוֹלָ֗ם לִנְתִב֣וֹת אֵי־ זֶ֨ה הַטּוֹב֙ דֶ֤רֶךְ וּלְכוּ־ בָ֔הּ וּמִצְא֥וּ מַרְגּ֖וֹעַ לְנַפְשְׁכֶ֑ם וַיֹּאמְר֖וּ לֹ֥א נֵלֵֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: kōh Yah·weh ’ā·mar ‘im·ḏū ‘al- də·rā·ḵîm ū·rə·’ū wə·ša·’ă·lū ‘ō·w·lām lin·ṯi·ḇō·wṯ ’ê- zeh haṭ·ṭō·wḇ ḏe·reḵ ū·lə·ḵū- ḇāh ū·miṣ·’ū mar·gō·w·a‘ lə·nap̄·šə·ḵem way·yō·mə·rū lō nê·lêḵ
verses.literal: This is what the LORD says Stand at the crossroads and look Ask for the ancient paths Where . . . [is] the good way Then walk in it and you will find rest for your souls But they said We will not walk in it

verses.original: וַהֲקִמֹתִ֤י צֹפִ֔ים עֲלֵיכֶם֙ הַקְשִׁ֖יבוּ לְק֣וֹל שׁוֹפָ֑ר וַיֹּאמְר֖וּ לֹ֥א נַקְשִֽׁיב׃
verses.transliteration: wa·hă·qi·mō·ṯî ṣō·p̄îm ‘ă·lê·ḵem haq·šî·ḇū lə·qō·wl šō·w·p̄ār way·yō·mə·rū lō naq·šîḇ
verses.literal: I appointed watchmen over you [and said] Listen for the sound of the ram’s horn But they answered We will not listen

verses.original: לָכֵ֖ן שִׁמְע֣וּ הַגּוֹיִ֑ם וּדְעִ֥י עֵדָ֖ה אֶת־ אֲשֶׁר־ בָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên šim·‘ū hag·gō·w·yim ū·ḏə·‘î ‘ê·ḏāh ’eṯ- ’ă·šer- bām
verses.literal: Therefore hear O nations and learn O congregations - what will happen to them

verses.original: שִׁמְעִ֣י הָאָ֔רֶץ הִנֵּ֨ה אָנֹכִ֜י מֵבִ֥יא רָעָ֛ה אֶל־ הַזֶּ֖ה הָעָ֥ם פְּרִ֣י מַחְשְׁבוֹתָ֑ם כִּ֤י לֹ֣א הִקְשִׁ֔יבוּ עַל־ דְּבָרַי֙ וַיִּמְאֲסוּ־ בָֽהּ׃ וְתוֹרָתִ֖י
verses.transliteration: šim·‘î hā·’ā·reṣ hin·nêh ’ā·nō·ḵî mê·ḇî rā·‘āh ’el- haz·zeh hā·‘ām pə·rî maḥ·šə·ḇō·w·ṯām kî lō hiq·šî·ḇū ‘al- də·ḇā·ray way·yim·’ă·sū- ḇāh wə·ṯō·w·rā·ṯî
verses.literal: Hear O earth - I am bringing disaster on this people the fruit of their own schemes because they have paid no attention to My word and have rejected My instruction

verses.original: לָמָּה־ זֶּ֨ה לִ֤י לְבוֹנָה֙ מִשְּׁבָ֣א תָב֔וֹא הַטּ֖וֹב וְקָנֶ֥ה מֶרְחָ֑ק מֵאֶ֣רֶץ עֹלֽוֹתֵיכֶם֙ לֹ֣א לְרָצ֔וֹן וְזִבְחֵיכֶ֖ם לֹא־ עָ֥רְבוּ לִֽי׃ס
verses.transliteration: lām·māh- zeh lî lə·ḇō·w·nāh miš·šə·ḇā ṯā·ḇō·w haṭ·ṭō·wḇ wə·qā·neh mer·ḥāq mê·’e·reṣ ‘ō·lō·w·ṯê·ḵem lō lə·rā·ṣō·wn wə·ziḇ·ḥê·ḵem lō- ‘ā·rə·ḇū lî
verses.literal: What use . . . to Me is frankincense from Sheba . . . or sweet cane from a distant land Your burnt offerings are not acceptable . . . your sacrifices do not please Me

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּ֚ה יְהוָ֔ה הִנְנִ֥י אָמַ֣ר נֹתֵ֛ן מִכְשֹׁלִ֑ים אֶל־ הַזֶּ֖ה הָעָ֥ם אָב֨וֹת וּבָנִ֥ים יַחְדָּ֛ו וְכָ֣שְׁלוּ בָ֠ם וְרֵע֖וֹ שָׁכֵ֥ן יֹאבֵדוּ׃פ
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên kōh Yah·weh hin·nî ’ā·mar nō·ṯên miḵ·šō·lîm ’el- haz·zeh hā·‘ām ’ā·ḇō·wṯ ū·ḇā·nîm yaḥ·dāw wə·ḵā·šə·lū ḇām wə·rê·‘ōw šā·ḵên yō·ḇē·ḏū
verses.literal: Therefore this is what the LORD . . . says I will lay stumbling blocks before this people fathers and sons alike will be staggered friends and neighbors will perish

verses.original: כֹּ֚ה יְהוָ֔ה אָמַ֣ר הִנֵּ֛ה עַ֥ם בָּ֖א מֵאֶ֣רֶץ צָפ֑וֹן גָּד֔וֹל וְג֣וֹי יֵע֖וֹר מִיַּרְכְּתֵי־ אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: kōh Yah·weh ’ā·mar hin·nêh ‘am bā mê·’e·reṣ ṣā·p̄ō·wn gā·ḏō·wl wə·ḡō·w yê·‘ō·wr mî·yar·kə·ṯê- ’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: This is what the LORD says Behold an army is coming from the land of the north a great nation is stirred up from the ends of the earth

verses.original: יַחֲזִ֗יקוּ קֶ֣שֶׁת וְכִיד֞וֹן הוּא֙ אַכְזָרִ֥י וְלֹ֣א יְרַחֵ֔מוּ קוֹלָם֙ יֶהֱמֶ֔ה כַּיָּ֣ם יִרְכָּ֑בוּ וְעַל־ סוּסִ֖ים עָר֗וּךְ כְּאִישׁ֙ לַמִּלְחָמָ֔ה עָלַ֖יִךְ בַּת־ צִיּֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: ya·ḥă·zî·qū qe·šeṯ wə·ḵî·ḏō·wn hū ’aḵ·zā·rî wə·lō yə·ra·ḥê·mū qō·w·lām ye·hĕ·meh kay·yām yir·kā·ḇū wə·‘al- sū·sîm ‘ā·rūḵ kə·’îš lam·mil·ḥā·māh ‘ā·la·yiḵ baṯ- ṣî·yō·wn
verses.literal: They grasp the bow and spear they [are] cruel vvv and merciless Their voice roars like the sea and they ride upon horses lined up like men in formation against you O Daughter of Zion

verses.original: שָׁמַ֥עְנוּ אֶת־ שָׁמְע֖וֹ יָדֵ֑ינוּ רָפ֣וּ צָרָה֙ הֶחֱזִיקַ֔תְנוּ חִ֖יל כַּיּוֹלֵדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: šā·ma‘·nū ’eṯ- šā·mə·‘ōw yā·ḏê·nū rā·p̄ū ṣā·rāh he·ḥĕ·zî·qaṯ·nū ḥîl kay·yō·w·lê·ḏāh
verses.literal: We have heard - the report our hands hang limp Anguish has gripped us pain like that of a woman in labor

verses.original: אַל־ תֵּצְאִי הַשָּׂדֶ֔ה אַל־ תֵּלֵכִי וּבַדֶּ֖רֶךְ כִּ֚י לְאֹיֵ֔ב חֶ֣רֶב מָג֖וֹר מִסָּבִֽיב׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- tē·ṣə·ʾī haś·śā·ḏeh ’al- tē·lē·ḵī ū·ḇad·de·reḵ kî lə·’ō·yêḇ ḥe·reḇ mā·ḡō·wr mis·sā·ḇîḇ
verses.literal: Do not go out to the fields do not walk the road For the enemy has a sword terror is on every side

verses.original: בַּת־ עַמִּ֤י חִגְרִי־ שָׂק֙ וְהִתְפַּלְּשִׁ֣י בָאֵ֔פֶר אֵ֤בֶל תַּמְרוּרִ֑ים מִסְפַּ֖ד עֲשִׂ֣י לָ֔ךְ יָחִיד֙ כִּ֣י פִתְאֹ֔ם הַשֹּׁדֵ֖ד יָבֹ֥א עָלֵֽינוּ׃
verses.transliteration: baṯ- ‘am·mî ḥiḡ·rî- śāq wə·hiṯ·pal·lə·šî ḇā·’ê·p̄er ’ê·ḇel tam·rū·rîm mis·paḏ ‘ă·śî lāḵ yā·ḥîḏ kî p̄iṯ·’ōm haš·šō·ḏêḏ yā·ḇō ‘ā·lê·nū
verses.literal: O daughter of my people dress yourselves in sackcloth and roll in ashes Mourn with bitter wailing as you would for an only son for suddenly the destroyer will come upon us

verses.original: נְתַתִּ֥יךָ בָּח֛וֹן בְעַמִּ֖י מִבְצָ֑ר וְתֵדַ֕ע וּבָחַנְתָּ֖ אֶת־ דַּרְכָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: nə·ṯat·tî·ḵā bā·ḥō·wn ḇə·‘am·mî miḇ·ṣār wə·ṯê·ḏa‘ ū·ḇā·ḥan·tā ’eṯ- dar·kām
verses.literal: I have appointed you to examine My people like ore so you may know and try - their ways

verses.original: כֻּלָּם֙ סֽוֹרְרִ֔ים סָרֵ֣י הֹלְכֵ֥י רָכִ֖יל נְחֹ֣שֶׁת וּבַרְזֶ֑ל כֻּלָּ֥ם מַשְׁחִיתִ֖ים הֵֽמָּה׃
verses.transliteration: kul·lām sō·wr·rîm sā·rê hō·lə·ḵê rā·ḵîl nə·ḥō·šeṯ ū·ḇar·zel kul·lām maš·ḥî·ṯîm hêm·māh
verses.literal: All are hardened rebels walking around as slanderers They are bronze and iron all of them are corrupt . . .

verses.original: מַפֻּ֔חַ נָחַ֣ר עֹפָ֑רֶת מֵאִשְׁתַּם צָרַ֣ף צָר֔וֹף לַשָּׁוְא֙ וְרָעִ֖ים לֹ֥א נִתָּֽקוּ׃
verses.transliteration: map·pu·aḥ nā·ḥar ‘ō·p̄ā·reṯ mē·ʾiš·tam ṣā·rap̄ ṣā·rō·wp̄ laš·šāw wə·rā·‘îm lō nit·tā·qū
verses.literal: The bellows blow fiercely {blasting away} the lead with fire The refining [proceeds] . . . in vain for the wicked are not purged

verses.original: קָרְא֖וּ לָהֶ֑ם נִמְאָ֔ס כֶּ֣סֶף כִּֽי־ יְהוָ֖ה מָאַ֥ס בָּהֶֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: qā·rə·’ū lā·hem nim·’ās ke·sep̄ kî- Yah·weh mā·’as bā·hem
verses.literal: They are called rejected silver because the LORD has rejected them
